improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
improve.coach: Steady at about 46% of matches. Steady means fixable; it's a habit, not a fluke.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
improve.coach: It's come up in 38% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
improve.coach: 60% of your last five, up from 38% overall. Time to put this one front and center.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: That ball had your name on it from the moment you set your feet. 62% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

coach.intro: Pull up a chair, tuxedo_slide. 13 matches of evidence, and I've got thoughts.
coach.name: Coach Lasso
